title: 隧道仰拱閉合施工
summary: 本課以以閉合環、接頭相容與基底反力解析隧道仰拱為主線，從閉合環與環向力與仰拱曲率與力線建立系統邊界，再把閉合距離與時間效應、地下水浮力與排水狀態連到永久環與維護交接。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on analyze tunnel inverts through ring closure, joint compatibility and base reactions. It begins with Ring closure and hoop force and Invert curvature and force trajectory, links Closure distance and time effects and Groundwater uplift and drainage state, and ends with Permanent ring and maintenance handover. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閉合環與環向力」與「仰拱曲率與力線」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring closure and hoop force" and "Invert curvature and force trajectory": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閉合環與環向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring closure and hoop force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閉合環與環向力」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ring closure and hoop force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。閉合不是外觀接觸而已，接頭必須能傳遞所需作用；模型應保留閉合前已發生的變形，不能把全部荷載重新從零分配。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態；若出現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閉合環與環向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending. Visible contact is not sufficient joint transfer. Retain preclosure deformation rather than reallocating the complete load from an artificial zero state. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ring closure and hoop force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閉合環與環向力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ring closure and hoop force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閉合環與環向力
knowledge.text: 拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。閉合不是外觀接觸而已，接頭必須能傳遞所需作用；模型應保留閉合前已發生的變形，不能把全部荷載重新從零分配。
knowledge.textEn: Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending. Visible contact is not sufficient joint transfer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閉合環與環向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring closure and hoop force" is correct?
options: 混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合
拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。
仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確
optionsEn: Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure
Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending.
Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct
quiz.explanation: 拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閉合環與環向力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring closure and hoop force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閉合環與環向力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ring closure and hoop force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閉合環與環向力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring closure and hoop force", which statement holds?
options: 基底被稱為岩盤就不可能發生可觀沉陷
仰拱外觀已硬化就能承受任何施工車輛
原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。
optionsEn: A base classified as rock cannot undergo significant settlement
An apparently hard invert can carry any construction vehicle
Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 閉合環與環向力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring closure and hoop force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合環與環向力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ring closure and hoop force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「閉合環與環向力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring closure and hoop force"?
options: 比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
閉合後監測曲線變平就一定是結構已穩定
optionsEn: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A flatter curve after closure necessarily proves structural stability
quiz.explanation: 比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 閉合環與環向力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring closure and hoop force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閉合環與環向力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ring closure and hoop force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態；若出現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「閉合環與環向力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring closure and hoop force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。
仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending.
Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct
quiz.explanation: 接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 仰拱曲率與力線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Invert curvature and force trajectory: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「仰拱曲率與力線」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Invert curvature and force trajectory” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 仰拱曲率影響軸力作用線與基底接觸，過度平坦可能增加彎曲需求。局部厚度和曲率誤差互相影響，不能只量最低點高程；應將設計曲線與完成面配準，辨認轉折、接頭及基底鬆動造成的非均勻受力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折；若出現局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「仰拱曲率與力線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Invert curvature governs the thrust trajectory and base contact, and flattening can increase bending demand. Thickness and curvature errors interact, so the lowest elevation alone is insufficient. Register the completed profile to identify kinks, joints and uneven loading from disturbed ground. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints. If a locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Invert curvature and force trajectory” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「仰拱曲率與力線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Invert curvature and force trajectory”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 仰拱曲率與力線
knowledge.text: 仰拱曲率影響軸力作用線與基底接觸，過度平坦可能增加彎曲需求。局部厚度和曲率誤差互相影響，不能只量最低點高程；應將設計曲線與完成面配準，辨認轉折、接頭及基底鬆動造成的非均勻受力。
knowledge.textEn: Invert curvature governs the thrust trajectory and base contact, and flattening can increase bending demand. Thickness and curvature errors interact, so the lowest elevation alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「仰拱曲率與力線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Invert curvature and force trajectory" is correct?
options: 仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確
接頭面積夠大就可以忽略界面污染
仰拱曲率影響軸力作用線與基底接觸，過度平坦可能增加彎曲需求。
optionsEn: Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct
Large joint area permits interface contamination to be ignored
Invert curvature governs the thrust trajectory and base contact, and flattening can increase bending demand.
quiz.explanation: 仰拱曲率影響軸力作用線與基底接觸，過度平坦可能增加彎曲需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Invert curvature governs the thrust trajectory and base contact, and flattening can increase bending demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 仰拱曲率與力線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Invert curvature and force trajectory: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「仰拱曲率與力線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Invert curvature and force trajectory” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「仰拱曲率與力線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Invert curvature and force trajectory", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m。
閉合距離相同就代表所有施工時間效應相同
隧道內沒有積水就代表仰拱底部沒有水壓
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m.
Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects
A dry tunnel interior proves there is no water pressure below the invert
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 仰拱曲率與力線：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Invert curvature and force trajectory: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「仰拱曲率與力線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Invert curvature and force trajectory” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「仰拱曲率與力線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Invert curvature and force trajectory"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折。
接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints.
Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened
quiz.explanation: 以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 仰拱曲率與力線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Invert curvature and force trajectory: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「仰拱曲率與力線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Invert curvature and force trajectory” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折；若出現局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「仰拱曲率與力線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Invert curvature and force trajectory" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接頭面積夠大就可以忽略界面污染
局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Large joint area permits interface contamination to be ignored
A locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks.
quiz.explanation: 局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
